original_ai_output.title_zh: IPCR呼吁尼日利亚人拒绝分裂性宗教叙事
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚和平与冲突解决研究所所长Joseph Ochogwu呼吁宗教领袖、政策制定者及其他利益相关方拒绝分裂性叙事，称此类叙事可能加深宗教紧张并削弱国家凝聚力。他于周五在阿布贾举行的政策审查对话会上发表上述讲话。该对话会由IPCR与阿卜杜拉国王国际宗教间与文化间对话中心合作举办。

key_facts.fact: IPCR所长Joseph Ochogwu呼吁宗教领袖和政策制定者拒绝分裂性叙事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Director-General of the Institute for Peace and Conflict Resolution, Joseph Ochogwu, has urged religious leaders, policymakers and other stakeholders to reject divisive narratives.

key_facts.fact: Ochogwu称分裂性叙事可能加深宗教紧张并削弱国家凝聚力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said such narratives were capable of deepening religious tensions and undermining national cohesion in the country.

key_facts.fact: 讲话于周五在阿布贾举行的政策审查对话会上发表
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ochogwu spoke on Friday in Abuja at the Quarterly Policy Review Dialogue of the Network of Policymakers and Religious Leaders to Support Peace, Security and Reconciliation in Nigeria.

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
正文为部分提取，信息可能不完整
